title: Normalization of the supplied inclusion tensor comparison
statement: The inclusion tensor comparison supplied by the six-functor common-stage data is heterogeneously equal to the canonical inclusion tensor comparison.

source.place: Compatibility; finite-stage representative and supplied-operation normalization.

proof.text: Identify the invertibility instances by subsingleton elimination. Expand the supplied comparison. Each of its three transports is heterogeneously equal to the transported term, leaving the canonical comparison itself.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility; explicit finite-model and scalar-unit cancellation.

theorem commonProjectionTensorComparison_heq
